notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Today I’m happy to announce the release of an early demo for Dragons Frolic! 

This demo features the basic loop of buying, breeding and selling little Dragons, as well as some shed building and decorating.


 There aren’t any racing mini games in this demo.
 The balancing of wait times and money might need more work! 
 Oh, and the demo doesn’t save yet, so if you close the demo you’ll have to restart.


If you have any feedback, I opened a demo feedback thread in the discussions section. 

Thank you very much.
